connector.name: Open Design MCP
connector.registryDescription: Open Design MCP capability governed by DigitalPipe.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.digitalpipe.net over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace net.digitalpipe.app, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer token issued by DigitalPipe for the connecting agent
